title: Migration 0011 preserves old mailbox_id computation, code expects new computation
description: Old code computed mailbox_id = SHA-256(user_id || role). New code computes mailbox_id = SHA-256(role). Migration 0011 copies OLD mailbox_id values from user_mailboxes to the new mailboxes table. When new provision_mailboxes code runs after migration, it tries to INSERT rows with the NEW mailbox_id values. But INSERT OR IGNORE skips (role is UNIQUE) so the database retains OLD mailbox_id values. If code later expects mailbox_id = SHA-256(role) and compares/rebuilds/validates IDs, it will find mismatches. The test provision_inbox_has_correct_id (line 145-156) expects the new ID, which will fail on an upgraded system. Correct behavior: either (a) update migration to recompute IDs as hash(role), or (b) update provision_mailboxes to keep old computation if user_id rows still exist.
